# Demi studio

I’m Demi. I’m interested in product management roles and bring 8+ years of e-commerce product operations experience at Lazada. I’m studying Product Management & UX Design.

## Current pages
- [Home](https://demi-studio.demihchong.workers.dev/): My introduction, skills, selected work, and outside-work interests. Both vinyl sides are in the Markdown version.
- [About me](https://demi-studio.demihchong.workers.dev/about.html): My professional background, current studies, experience, education, languages, and dance and music interests. All interactive story panels are in the Markdown version.
- [LazLook](https://demi-studio.demihchong.workers.dev/lazlook.html): A case study draft about a fashion shopping channel, its assortment constraints, and my local operations contribution. Outcomes and reflections are incomplete.
